english.note: Use 洗 as the all-purpose verb for cleaning something or oneself with water.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 sai2 gon1 zing6 di1 wun2 sin1

english.note: Use 洗 with film or photographs as the object when you mean to develop them.

examples.english: Can you develop this roll of film today?
examples.traditional: 今日可唔可以幫我洗呢筒菲林呀？
examples.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bong1 ngo5 sai2 ni1 tung2 fei1 lam4 aa3
